newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia airlifts 100 citizens from Phnom penh.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia airlifts 100 citizens from Phnom penh.

text.p: Malaysia started evacuating its citizens from strife-torn Cambodia, with the first 100 expected to arrive in Malaysia late on Tuesday, a spokesman for Malaysia Airlines (MAS) said.
He said a special MAS Boeing 737 would carry the evacuees into Kuala Lumpur by 2145 local time (1345 GMT).
"It is a special flight. But we don't know about any more flights yet," the official said.
Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has said there were about 400-500 Malaysians in Cambodia, where fighting between forces of the rival leaders of the ruling coalition has caused some 58 deaths.
